knowledge: All rules, supplies, goals and every legal join/recipe are available. Policies have implementation access. Mechanical diagnostics only, not blind play or fun judgments.

geometry.model: Rigid polyomino fusion; rotations allowed; every edge-adjacent, non-overlapping join legal within5×5 bound. Goal silhouette uses all10 cells.

contextReversal.meaning: The visible target geometry reverses opening feasibility; this is not a preference/enjoyment rating.

globalCompletionReversal.meaning: Both joined shapes individually fit both visible targets. Only the ability to place the remaining pieces reverses; this tests global completion beyond immediate outline matching.

geometry.forwardRecovery: A component that cannot tile the target cannot be unjoined by later fusions. Recovery requires Undo; do not call this forward recovery.
limits: Targets generated from the fixed stock; twelve rotation-distinct connected shapes, no policy-outcome filtering.
Exact-cover planner is privileged; a complete tiling implies an edge-fusion continuation for a connected target.
Winning final outlines are necessarily identical; different interleavings are not counted as expressive outcomes.
A target may be a familiar jigsaw with one insight; enjoyment and visual obviousness need browser/human inspection.

allocation.model: Finite consumable materials; explicit recipe hypergraph; visible water/cover capability requirements. No production timers.

contextReversal.meaning: Competing visible needs reverse feasibility with exactly the same supplies and recipes. This is a coarse capability-budget model, not a world simulation.

limits: Capability values abstract away actual world effects. This can be a shopping-list puzzle rather than an engaging situation.
Terminal signatures group resulting capabilities and unused stock, not recipe order.
Some shortest solutions repeatedly make Clay; inspect physical repetition before retaining the economy.
Cases intentionally vary competing needs with fixed supplies; this is not a population or statistical sample.

recommendation: Prototype geometry-sensitive joining first. It puts the decision inside the protected gesture. Use exact previews and Undo; test whether a locally tempting join changes future fit. Keep finite allocation as a reserve; reject it if its planning is only a mandatory shopping list. Process maturation is sketched/rejected before implementation because the small version needs filler mixes or a forced bread chain.
